10897|c5ceacbe.name: Sindrayl
10897|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11799|992f6a78.name: Tajarri
11799|992f6a78.text:
The Shrine of Remulos is a sacred place for us in the Cenarion Circle here in Moonglade... so please conduct yourself in a manner befitting a visitor.

A visitor who doesn't want my scimitar buried in them, that is.

11800|d5d73f6c.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|d5d73f6c.text:
In the northern part of Darkshore runs the Cliffspring River, flowing down from the lands now known as Felwood.  As the river flows out and empties out into the Mist's Edge, travel north to where the deepest parts of the ocean begin.  A stone formation that some call the Stone Claw due to its shape is where you may find what you seek.

Be warned - threshers gather by the Stone Claw, and will attack those who trespass on their territory.

12042|a2527c6f.name: Loganaar
12042|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

12656|307aaccf.name: Thamarian
12656|307aaccf.text:
On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus. From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan, and onwards to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you head to the western dock, you can board a ship setting sail for Stormwind.

Safe journeys to you!

1313|0624ab70.name: Maria Lumere
1313|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

203475|b68afaa1.name: Liv Bradford
203475|b68afaa1.text: Hi there. What can I get for you?

203478|01ff6526.name: Stuart
203478|01ff6526.text: Oy, you there! *hic* You got some kinda problem pal?

2277|985afd1f.name: Loremaster Dibbs
2277|985afd1f.text: Hello, $N! What can I do for you?

2367|279d82d3.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

246848|59873409.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|59873409.text: What is your curiosity looking for?

253474|0eb9c156.name: Peacekeeper
253474|0eb9c156.text: The High Order's transport to Azeroth can be found at the furthest dock on the southeastern edge of Valanaar.

253474|ba9ef707.name: Peacekeeper
253474|ba9ef707.text: You'll find Lotheluum Starbreeze on a cliff overlooking the waterfall on the eastern edge of town.

256306|f652f067.name: Arcanist Laurain
256306|f652f067.text:
Welcome to Dalaran, $c. 

Please pay no mind to some of the construction that is still underway. Oh, and should you encounter a rogue arcane anomaly, demon, or other malign entity, please feel free to seek assistance from the nearest member of the Kirin Tor before fleeing--um... proceeding--to the nearest exit in an orderly fashion!

<Arcanist Laurain laughs nervously.>

Thank you for visiting!

258912|5774bb86.name: Elaren Stargrove
258912|5774bb86.text: You are welcome here in Moonglade. Take a seat beside me if you like, but please be mindful of the moonwater.

261579|479b42b2.name: Riding Spotted Frostsaber
261579|479b42b2.text: <The saber lets out a low grumble as you near it, then returns to its nap with a huff.>

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

269127|1e33d6fe.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127|1e33d6fe.text:
If you've tried to enter Dalaran, you've likely met with the Kirin Tor guards. They are under strict orders not to let outsiders into the city while this disruption runs rampant. The council has decreed that keeping up appearances is more important than preventing a catastrophe.

I suffer no such delusions.

274942|7db6413a.name: Bob McNaught
274942|7db6413a.text: Used to have a shop in Strahnbrad. Good little place. Had customers. Had walls. Had a roof.

276732|f26348b8.name: Swift Frostsaber
276732|f26348b8.text: <The great cat lets out a small huff as you near it.>

2859|2cc67a59.name: Gyll
2859|2cc67a59.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

32287|1d779665.name: Archmage Alvareaux
32287|1d779665.text:
Greetings, I am Archmage Alvereaux and I manage supply and logistics for the Kirin Tor.

Unfortunately, we have relatively few useful items available for disbursement to our friends and allies at present.

I suggest checking back often, as available stock may change from time to time.

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4730|aa0a0c2b.name: Lelanai
4730|aa0a0c2b.text: Alas $c, you are not considered to be exalted to Darnassus and the night elves of Teldrassil.  Only when you prove yourself to us through deeds - not just mere words - will I then make available my selection of mounts for your perusal.

4753|fd225a01.name: Jartsam
4753|fd225a01.text: You need to be exalted with the night elves of Darnassus before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

5499|56eb712c.name: Lilyssia Nightbreeze
5499|56eb712c.text: Listen carefully, $N, for I have much knowledge to impart.

5505|a2527c6f.name: Theridran
5505|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

727|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

1008-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-accept.text:
There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas.  It has been lost to the night elves for ages.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!

Return to me when your mission is complete.
1008-accept.title: The Zoram Strand

101-accept.name: Madame Eva
101-accept.text:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-accept.title: The Totem of Infliction

1070-accept.name: Sentinel Thenysil
1070-accept.text:
Hello, $N.

You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.

Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure.

Would you find her and report back to me?
1070-accept.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

1070-complete.name: Kaela Shadowspear
1070-complete.text:
Ah, you've come from Ashenvale at the behest of Tara--how I miss her, my homeland and friends. She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. I'm proud of her.

It is a pleasure to meet you, $N.
1070-complete.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

1071-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1071-accept.text:
You see, $N, I'm a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and it's my goal... nay, my DUTY! to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms can help save their forests.

But it's a hard fought war, and the goblins reproduce like rabbits it seems. I haven't even had time to build my newest inventions!

I need some time to plan and organize. But to do that, I need your help keeping the goblins at bay in Windshear Crag to the east...
1071-accept.title: A Gnome's Respite

1085-accept.name: Kaela Shadowspear
1085-accept.text:
The situation here in Stonetalon is obviously grave for a night elf and gnome to be working together.

The Venture Co. has devastated these lands and I've spent most of my time putting an end to the destruction.

Do not judge Gaxim prematurely; he understands the need for us to work together.

If you wish to aid us, then start by speaking to Gaxim.

I'm sorry I cannot send you back to Tara with good news yet. Perhaps soon.
1085-accept.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

1085-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1085-complete.text:
Treacherous... treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.

But I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.

See, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves--they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. The possibilities are endless.
1085-complete.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

124-complete.name: Verner Osgood
124-complete.text: Thank you for all your help, $N.
124-complete.title: A Baying of Gnolls

126-accept.name: Verner Osgood
126-accept.text:
$N, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.

Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
126-accept.title: Howling in the Hills

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-complete.text:
By the Light!  The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall.  And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire?  There is some treachery abound.  How could this be so? 

Oh I forgot to reward your service, $c.  Here are some coins.  Now excuse me.  Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
146-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

150-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

It's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
150-complete.title: Murloc Poachers

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

164-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
164-accept.text:
Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
164-accept.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
165-accept.text: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
165-accept.title: The Hermit

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2178-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-accept.text:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, $N--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
2178-accept.title: Easy Strider Living

245-accept.name: Watcher Dodds
245-accept.text:
Hail, $c. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
245-accept.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

250-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
250-accept.text:
Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam.  First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr!  I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat.  Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.

That's why I need you, $N.  I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam.   Investigate the area and bring back a clue.
250-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

26-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
26-accept.text:
$N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
26-accept.title: A Lesson to Learn

26-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
26-complete.text:
Salutations, young $c; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form.  It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water.  You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.

You will face two trials to overcome.  The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure.  The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.

Stand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.
26-complete.title: A Lesson to Learn

272-accept.name: Tajarri
272-accept.text:
For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion.  One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect.  Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.

Speak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together.  Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
272-accept.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

272-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-complete.text:
You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, $N - congratulations.

Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater.  Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.

Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
272-complete.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

272-progress.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-progress.text: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N?  If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information.  Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
272-progress.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

29-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
29-accept.text:
For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble.  It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste.  Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.

You only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves.  Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.

Good luck, $N.
29-accept.title: Trial of the Lake

29-complete.name: Tajarri
29-complete.text:
Well now, it looks like yet another $c has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake!  Well done, my young friend - well done.

As I've said, my name is Tajarri.  It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade, and specifically this shrine.  Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such.  By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
29-complete.title: Trial of the Lake

2923-accept.name: Brother Sarno
2923-accept.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot.  I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

Very sad.  But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge.  He would welcome your help.
2923-accept.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

334-accept.name: Rema Schneider
334-accept.text:
My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great $C like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

Please, $N.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
334-accept.title: Package for Thurman

343-accept.name: Brother Kristoff
343-accept.text:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
343-accept.title: Speaking of Fortitude

343-complete.name: Milton Sheaf
343-complete.text: Metallurgy?  Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech!  Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
343-complete.title: Speaking of Fortitude

344-accept.name: Milton Sheaf
344-accept.text:
The Stresses of Iron?  Yes, I know the book.  Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago.  He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore.  Smart fellow!

But where was I?  Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron!  I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey.  The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

But that was months ago.  I wonder why it's taking him so long...
344-accept.title: Brother Paxton

344-complete.name: Brother Paxton
344-complete.text: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is?  Well this is a tad embarrassing.  I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!
344-complete.title: Brother Paxton

345-accept.name: Brother Paxton
345-accept.text:
I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...

Well you see, I make my own ink for books I copy.  It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly  Unfortunately, it dries too quickly!  My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!

To make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the Redridge Mountains.  Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.
345-accept.title: Ink Supplies

345-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
345-complete.text: You need what??  Maybe you haven't noticed, but we're busy fortifying Lakeshire's defenses and repairing damage from recent orc attacks.  If you need Rethban Iron Ore, you'll have to get it yourself!
345-complete.title: Ink Supplies

347-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
347-accept.text:
Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban.  When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes.  It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any.  And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.

So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
347-accept.title: Rethban Ore

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

387-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
387-accept.text:
The uprising must be quelled!  I need your assistance.  If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job!  This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one.  But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.

The punishment for insurgency is death.  Kill some of these deviants!  That ought to get things under control.
387-accept.title: Quell the Uprising

5-accept.name: Jitters
5-accept.text:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
5-accept.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

5-complete.name: Chef Grual
5-complete.text: You need some Crab Cakes, do you?  Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
5-complete.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

5061-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5061-accept.text:
You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect.  Go now back to your trainer, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, in Darnassus.  Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you.  He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.

Goodbye, young $c.  We shall speak again.
5061-accept.title: Aquatic Form

5061-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-complete.text:
Very impressive, $N.  You are ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.

Also, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item.  I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.
5061-complete.title: Aquatic Form

5061-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-progress.text:
Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
5061-progress.title: Aquatic Form

5321-accept.name: Kerlonian Evershade
5321-accept.text:
I was on my way to Maestra's Post to meet Liladris Moonriver, but I decided to stop here and take a short nap. Ever since I awoke from the emerald dream, I have been so sleepy...

<yawn>

And I can't find my things anywhere! Would you mind helping me find them?

I understand that Maestra's Post is south of here, along the road in Ashenvale. I had come from that way...

Lastly, I may fall asleep so if you ever need to wake me, please use my horn. You'll find it in the chest here.
5321-accept.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened

56-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-accept.text:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
56-accept.title: The Night Watch

6121-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
6121-accept.text:
You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $N.  Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation.  This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.

Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
6121-accept.title: Lessons Anew

6121-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6121-complete.text:
Greetings young $c, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing.  There has been a rash of animal poisonings in Auberdine, and the village there has been unable to cure it.  To that end, a representative there has asked Moonglade for aid and we are sending you there to aid them.  This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real.  Bear this in mind.
6121-complete.title: Lessons Anew

6122-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6122-accept.text:
The Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region, and now I suspect it is the principal source of the poison that is harming the local fauna - deer specifically.  Use this sampler to draw some water from the mouth of the cave; be careful, as dangerous naga now reside in a cave by the falls.

Once filled, deliver it to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.  She is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with her to address this malady.
6122-accept.title: The Principal Source

6122-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6122-complete.text:
By Elune, this water is disgusting!  No wonder the deer are sick.

Something is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting Darkshore's entire water table.  Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river.  While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.

This water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure.  While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...
6122-complete.title: The Principal Source

6122-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6122-progress.text:
You're the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent?  That's wonderful!  We've quite the crisis our hands here regarding the poor deer, and we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have?  He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
6122-progress.title: The Principal Source

6123-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-accept.text:
The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I'll make for the deer.  For curative properties, I need some earthroot.  Herbalists know how to find it, so if we're unlucky and you aren't one then you'll need to find one to help us out.

Finally for potency, I need some lunar fungus.  Finding lunar fungal blooms is easy enough; they're all over the place in caves just to the east of here.  Moonkin reside in the caves and they're irritable as of late, so be careful.
6123-accept.title: Gathering the Cure

6123-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-complete.text:
This is good, $N, so much so that it should be enough to make some ample doses of the salve - at least enough to start to make a difference.

Making a cure for poisons can be quite difficult at times because each one often requires a very specific antidote to counteract it.  Imagine being able to cure a poison at will without having to worry about the exact ingredients of what the antidote must be!

Now, let me get to work on this!
6123-complete.title: Gathering the Cure

6123-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-progress.text: Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve?  The deer aren't getting any better on their own, so we better hurry to help them out!
6123-progress.title: Gathering the Cure

6124-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6124-accept.text:
The amount of salve made out of the reagents you brought me is good enough for ten doses, $N.  While I work with the village to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start.  All around Darkshore are sickly deer; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure.  Please extend Auberdine's thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!
6124-accept.title: Curing the Sick

6124-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6124-complete.text:
You have done well in tending to the sickly deer of Darkshore; they are unwitting victims of a greater taint and corruption that is spreading all throughout the land.  There are those in Darnassus who choose to recognize this threat... and there are those who ignore the growing signs.  I hope you will not be one to put blinders on about what facts stare you in the face, $N.

Regardless, you've proven your worth as a friend of nature and the Circle - take this as a symbol of such.
6124-complete.title: Curing the Sick

6125-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
6125-accept.text:
You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid.  Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.

You should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, $N.  He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto him.

Farewell, young $c.  We shall speak again.
6125-accept.title: Power over Poison

6125-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
6125-complete.text:
Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation in Auberdine.  This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.

You handled yourself with grace under pressure.  For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison.  Use it well, $N... use it well.
6125-complete.title: Power over Poison

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

89-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
89-complete.text: Great work, $N.  These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely.  We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
89-complete.title: The Everstill Bridge

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

90-accept.name: Chef Grual
90-accept.text: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.
90-accept.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

92-complete.name: Chef Breanna
92-complete.text: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
92-complete.title: Redridge Goulash

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92110-complete.name: Odd Child
92110-complete.text:
You brought me murloc eyes! I am so, so excited for my first REAL potion!

I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.

<The child watches enthusiastically as you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>

Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!
92110-complete.title: My First Real Potion

92110-progress.name: Odd Child
92110-progress.text: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
92110-progress.title: My First Real Potion

92415-progress.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-progress.text: What is it, $N? What are you looking for?
92415-progress.title: Remember That I Love You

92479-accept.name: Marshal McBride
92479-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local $c trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479-accept.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.
92479-complete.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-progress.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
92479-progress.title: A Scribbled Letter

93-accept.name: Chef Grual
93-accept.text:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
93-accept.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straits indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94485-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485-accept.title: Tears of the Lady

94486-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486-accept.title: Feathers for Binding

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

95189-complete.name: Lady Dena Kennedy
95189-complete.text:
How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered.

Thank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, $c. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.
95189-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95189-progress.name: Lady Dena Kennedy
95189-progress.text: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.
95189-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195-progress.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-progress.text: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195-progress.title: Bloodied Insignia

95250-accept.name: Aerith
95250-accept.text:
What do you want, $r? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250-accept.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust a filthy lesser breed like you. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: You're still alive? Hmmph. Well, what is it? Have you found my lord yet?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures

98341-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98341-accept.text:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
98341-accept.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98341-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98341-complete.text:
Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.

I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of an Azerothian cat spirit.

Let us begin.
98341-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98386-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-complete.text:
The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!
98386-complete.title: Alther's Mill

98393-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
98393-accept.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young $c. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393-accept.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98393-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98393-complete.text:
And so it continues, Father Cenarius.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>

Greetings again, $N. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.
98393-complete.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98397-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98397-accept.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397-accept.title: To Darnassus

98397-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
98397-complete.text:
Welcome back, $N. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.

I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.
98397-complete.title: To Darnassus

98404-accept.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-accept.text:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
98404-accept.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-complete.text:
Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $c.
98404-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-progress.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-progress.text: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404-progress.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98459-accept.name: Tom "Half-fish" Wilson
98459-accept.text:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459-accept.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-complete.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-complete.text:
<Bart unwraps the gift.>

Why that no good, son of a--

Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!

I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--

I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
98459-complete.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-progress.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-progress.text:
Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!

Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
98459-progress.title: A Lack of Virtue

98738-accept.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98738-accept.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.

Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.

May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.
98738-accept.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98738-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98738-complete.text:
<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.

Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.
98738-complete.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit
